text: Even Pokémon of the same species can be all\nsorts of different sizes.

label: a_sch_room03_eve04
text: We’re seeing how big our Pokémon are!\c\nWe heard there’s someone in the city who loves\nseeing Pokémon that’re really big or small.

label: a_sch_room03_eve07
text: Look at its chubby little neck! Pikachu’s just the\ncutest!

label: a_sch_room03_eve08
text: Folks say Pikachu look different depending\non their gender.\c\nBut I dunno what the difference is!

label: a_sch_room03_ni02
text: My Gastly’s quite timid by nature, so it’s not the\nbest at hitting hard...but it can sure move fast!

label: a_sch_room03_ni03
text:
These Murkrow are nocturnal, but people say
they stay here in the lab even when the sun’s up.\c
I wonder if they hide themselves away during the
day so they’re not disturbed?
